title: Exome sequencing for children
what: This is a large genetic test that reads almost all of a child's genes at once. It helps find the cause of an illness when other tests gave no answer.
why: For developmental delay, birth defects, seizures, unusual physical features, or illnesses that could not be explained.
duration: the blood draw usually takes 5 to 10 minutes; results usually come in several weeks
tell_doctor: All of the child's diagnoses and tests. Bring the reports
Conditions in the family, and if the parents are related
If the child had a blood transfusion, and when
If other genetic tests were done before

prepare.title: Counseling
prepare.text: Before the test, a geneticist will talk with you about what the test can and cannot find.

prepare.title: Parents
prepare.text: Often both mom and dad are asked to give blood too. This makes the result more accurate. Check with the clinic.

prepare.title: Food
prepare.text: Your child usually does not need to fast.

prepare.title: Your child
prepare.text: Explain in simple words that there will be a quick prick. Bring a toy or a tablet.

bring: ID for the child and parents
All doctors' reports and past genetic tests
steps: You sit with your child. You can hold them on your lap
The nurse wipes the skin on the arm with antiseptic
A quick prick, and blood goes into a tube
If needed, the parents give blood too
The tubes are sent to a genetics lab
feel: The prick is quick. Little ones often cry. Pick your child up right away
Parents are often more anxious than the child. That is normal. Ask the geneticist questions
after: Results usually come in several weeks
A geneticist explains the result at a separate visit
The test does not find a cause in every child. That does not mean there is nothing more to look for
The data can be reviewed again later, as science learns more

faq.q: Why do the parents need to give blood?
faq.a: It shows the lab which changes the child got from the parents and which are new. This helps find the cause.
That happens. The doctor will decide if other tests or a later review of the data are needed.

reminders.text: Your child's genetic test is tomorrow. Bring ID and doctors' reports. The parents may also give blood.
